definition: [ כֶּ֫סֶת ] noun feminine band, fillet (= charm or amulet according to Ehpraimitic source Syriac, φυλακτήρια according to ὁ Ἑβραῖος of Hexapl., compare RS JPh xiii, 286 ; in Late Hebrew כסת usually = cushion, bolster, pillow ), only plural מְתַפְּרוֺת כְּסָתוֺת עַלֿ Ezek 13:18 women sewing bands upon elbows; with suffix 2 feminine plural כִּסְתוֺתֵיכֶ֫נָה v Ezek 13:20 . כֶּסֶה see כֶּסֶא . כִּסֵּה see כִּסֵּא .

[כֶּ֫סֶת] noun feminine band, fillet (= charm or amulet according to Ehpraimitic source Syriac, φυλακτήρια according to ὁ Ἑβραῖος of Hexapl., compare RSJPh xiii, 286; in Late Hebrew כסת usually = cushion, bolster, pillow), only plural מְתַפְּרוֺת כְּסָתוֺת עַלֿ Ezek 13:18 women sewing bands upon elbows; with suffix 2 feminine plural כִּסְתוֺתֵיכֶ֫נָה vEzek 13:20.

כֶּסֶה see כֶּסֶא.

כִּסֵּה see כִּסֵּא.
